editionLabel: Little Rocket Games English rulebook, version 2
firstPlayerRule: The player who last went into a barnyard goes first.
clarifications: If nobody has been in a barnyard, choose the first player randomly.
internalEvidence: Visually checked page 4 of the publisher-hosted English version 2 PDF. It gives the last-barnyard-visitor criterion, random fallback when nobody has visited, and clockwise play.
